name: Machine Learning
short_description: Supervised learning, unsupervised clustering, feature engineering, and evaluation.
description: Mathematical formulations and algorithmic implementation of regression, decision trees, support vector machines, clustering, dimensionality reduction, regularization, and cross-validation.

courses.title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
courses.description: Core algorithms in supervised learning, unsupervised clustering, and statistical validation.

modules.title: ML Workflow
modules.description: Problem framing, train/validation/test splits, and baseline models.

topics.title: The End-to-End ML Pipeline
topics.summary: Data ingestion, leakage prevention, and experiment logging.

modules.title: Data Preparation
modules.description: Missing value imputation, categorical encoding, scaling, and normalization.

topics.title: Feature Scaling & One-Hot Encoding
topics.summary: StandardScaler vs MinMaxScaler and handling high-cardinality features.

modules.title: Regression
modules.description: Ordinary Least Squares, gradient descent, Mean Squared Error loss.

topics.title: Linear Regression & Gradient Descent
topics.summary: Normal equation, analytical derivation, and iterative gradient updates.

modules.title: Classification
modules.description: Logistic regression, decision trees, Random Forests, and SVMs.

topics.title: Logistic Regression & Decision Trees
topics.summary: Sigmoid activations, log loss, Gini impurity, and information gain.

topics.title: k-NN, Naive Bayes & Support Vector Machines
topics.summary: Instance-based, probabilistic, and maximum-margin classifiers compared.

topics.title: Ensemble Methods: Bagging, Random Forests & Boosting
topics.summary: Combining many models to reduce variance or bias.

modules.title: Clustering
modules.description: K-Means, hierarchical agglomerative clustering, and DBSCAN.

topics.title: K-Means & Density-Based Clustering
topics.summary: Centroid initialization, elbow method, and density reachability.

modules.title: Feature Engineering
modules.description: Domain features, interaction terms, and PCA dimensionality reduction.

topics.title: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
topics.summary: Eigenvectors, covariance matrix decomposition, and variance retention.

modules.title: Model Evaluation
modules.description: Confusion matrix, Precision, Recall, F1 score, ROC-AUC curves.

topics.title: Classification Metrics & ROC Curves
topics.summary: Type I vs Type II errors, PR curves, and AUC statistical power.

topics.title: Cross-Validation & Model Selection
topics.summary: Train, validation, and test splits, k-fold cross-validation, and hyperparameter search.

modules.title: Overfitting & Regularization
modules.description: Bias-variance trade-off, L1 Lasso, L2 Ridge, and elastic net penalization.

topics.title: L1/L2 Regularization & Bias-Variance
topics.summary: Shrinkage penalties, sparsity induction, and cross-validation tuning.

modules.title: Reinforcement Learning
modules.description: Learning to act from rewards rather than labels.

topics.title: Reinforcement Learning Fundamentals
topics.summary: Agents and rewards, Markov decision processes, and Q-learning.
